visual_action: A montage of scenes at the White House. It includes a military helicopter landing on the lawn, exterior shots of the building, people on a balcony, a fireworks display at night, a woman bowling in an alley, the American flag on the White House lawn, a group of young people posing for a photo with Donald Trump inside a formal room, and Trump walking outside while people wave American flags.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is a montage of scenes in and around the White House building and grounds. The text 'POV: You're an intern at the White House' is displayed throughout.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown in two scenes: standing in front of a group of interns indoors, and walking on a path on the White House grounds.

cast.name: Unnamed White House interns
cast.evidence: The video is framed as the 'Point of View' of an intern. A large group of young adults, consistent in appearance with interns, are shown posing for a photo with Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text: POV: You're an intern at the White House

spoken_summary: The video features a song with a female vocalist singing lyrics including, "Since we found out, since we found out that anything could happen, anything could happen."
audio_music: An upbeat, inspirational pop song ('Anything Could Happen' by Ellie Goulding) with lyrics that evoke a sense of wonder and limitless possibility, complementing the visuals of a prestigious and exciting internship.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage of short clips, creating a dynamic and engaging highlight reel of the internship experience.
central_claim: An internship at the White House under the Trump administration is a prestigious, exciting, and fun-filled experience with unique opportunities.
intended_effect: To inspire young people to apply for a White House internship by showcasing it as an aspirational and once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
